ui.about_construction: Saw planks from logs, then build carts for the Trader, frames for the Inventor and rooms for your estate. Construction opens with the Trader.
ui.about_trader: Fill towns' orders and send caravans of your goods. Caravans bring back spices for Cooking, dye for Crafting and glass for lenses. Prices move in a cycle you can see ahead.
ui.about_estate: Rise from commoner to duke by paying gold, building rooms and proving yourself. Rooms make skills better, servants work alongside you, and the estate pays by the hour.
ui.about_workshop: Take apart things you made for parts, research blueprints, and build gadgets for your tools and machines that work alongside you. Build an invention again to improve it.
ui.about_observatory: Six signs rise in turn. Training a skill under its sign gathers starlight; meditate with it, and with runes, for Attunement. Its rewards are time: a longer away limit, astral runes and faster crops.

ui.regions_intro: The world opens in five regions. Each adds new trees, rocks, fish and crops, new things to make, its own enemies, champions, recipes and towns, a dungeon, and a new tier of every engine. A region opens at a total level and closes again when you prestige. The Beyond opens only once the Cult has opened the veil, and prestige closes the veil again.

Each cycle the rites with their full crew are cast. Cultists performing rites make the cycle faster and the rites surer; so does devotion, which grows steadily while rites run and researchers study. ui.about_exploration: Send a party of followers, knights, servants and cultists on expeditions to old manors, crypts and stranger places. They answer offerings, pass checks and fight, and bring back things found nowhere else.
ui.explore_intro: Choose a site, pick a party of knights and give each food and runes, then send them; each fights with its own gear. A beaten knight comes home and rests. An expedition fails if an offering's time runs out or everyone is beaten: the site starts over, you keep what was found, and everyone sent rests.

ui.dungeon_blurb_goblin_warren: Beneath the Vale's farmland, the goblins have dug a warren of stolen grain and sharpened sticks. Their raids grow bolder each harvest, and at the warren's heart the Goblin warlord counts his plunder and dreams of a crown.
ui.dungeon_blurb_giants_barrow: The hill giants bury their dead with their weapons, and their dead do not rest easy. A Black knight keeps the barrow's gate for reasons of his own, and deep among the cairns the Giant chieftain still sits his stone throne.
ui.dungeon_blurb_dragons_lair: For a hundred years the Vale has paid its tribute and kept its eyes from the mountain. Past spiders, giants and the knights who swore to guard it, the Elder dragon sleeps upon the hoard of every village it has burned.
ui.dungeon_blurb_smugglers_cove: The Coast's honest harbours close at dusk; Smugglers' Cove opens. Contraband changes hands in the tide caves, and the Pirate captain takes a cut of every crate, and of anyone who asks where it came from.
ui.dungeon_blurb_drowned_temple: The sea took the temple and its priests in a single night. Now they serve a new god. Sirens sing from its flooded halls, and on a throne of coral the Drowned king waits for the tide to bring him more subjects.
ui.dungeon_blurb_sunken_ship: The flagship of a forgotten fleet lies broken on the reef, its holds still heavy with gold. Every crew that has gone down for it has joined the wreck. Something vast coils in the deep below the keel: the Kraken does not share.
ui.dungeon_blurb_wolf_den: Travellers on the high passes hear the howling long before they see the eyes. The den reeks of bone and old blood, and the pack answers to the Wolf king, a beast as clever as any highwayman and twice as hungry.
ui.dungeon_blurb_yeti_caves: The yetis carve their caves deep into the glacier, and they do not carve alone. Old golems of living stone stand guard where the ice turns to rock, and at the mountain's root the Stone colossus has begun to wake.
ui.dungeon_blurb_frozen_halls: A fallen kingdom's palace lies entombed in the Peaks' oldest ice. Trolls and harpies roam its frozen galleries, and from the shattered throne room the Griffin queen rules the sky above it all.
ui.dungeon_blurb_scorpion_pit: The imps of the Wastes keep a pit for sport. Scorpions, salamanders and the desperate are thrown in together, and the Imp lord laughs from the rim. Climb out, and he will have to come down to you.
ui.dungeon_blurb_ash_catacombs: Beneath the dunes lie the catacombs of a city that burned for a thousand years. Its ashes walk, its guardians still answer riddles, and in the deepest vault the Ash titan smoulders, waiting for a fire worth rekindling.
ui.dungeon_blurb_ember_depths: Where the Wastes split open, a river of magma runs down to the world's forge. Elementals stoke it, golems guard it, and coiled around the heart of the flame the Ember wyrm has slept since the sun was young.
ui.dungeon_blurb_shade_hollow: Past the veil, the Hollow was once a monastery of the faithful. Its monks still keep their silent vigil, though they have long since forgotten what they prayed to. The Hollow abbot remembers, and he would rather you did not.
ui.dungeon_blurb_rift_maze: The Rift Maze was never built: it grew, folding in on itself where the Beyond tears thinnest. Dream eaters drift through its corridors, the Dream queen holds court in a room that is never in the same place twice, and the Rift colossus guards the only way out.
ui.dungeon_blurb_null_choir: Past the Unmaking, a choir sings the world quiet. Blades and spells fall silent in its hymn; only arrows reach the null cantor, and only cloth woven for magic turns its voice aside.
ui.dungeon_blurb_airless_vault: A vault under the Sea of Tranquillity with no air to breathe and no time to eat. What you carry in is all you have, and the vacuum warden grows angrier the longer you stay.
ui.dungeon_blurb_spectrum_trial: At the Heart of light the spectrum turns. Its weakness changes every few blows, and only armour of the colour it wears now will hold.
ui.dungeon_blurb_the_unmaking: At the end of all things stands the place where things end. Void knights march its halls, stars are swallowed whole in its depths, and at its centre the unmaker waits to undo the world, beginning with whoever comes to stop it.
ui.dungeon_blurb_crawler_warren: Under the Moon's grey dust, the regolith crawlers have tunnelled a warren beneath the first colony's landing site. The colonists' bandits learned to live alongside them. The Dust tyrant learned to rule them both.
ui.dungeon_blurb_moth_dome: The colony's great greenhouse dome went dark one night and never lit again. Now the moon moths nest among its broken panes, golems tend gardens for no one, and the Queen of moths sings the Crater colossus to sleep.
ui.dungeon_blurb_sea_of_tranquillity: There is nothing tranquil about the Sea of Tranquillity. Every horror of the Moon is drawn to its silent plain, and at its centre, beneath the Earth's cold light, the Warden of the moon guards a secret older than either world.
